Quick Read

  • NVTS surged 91% YTD on 800V AI data center momentum, while AOSL offers similar server-power exposure at just 8x forward earnings.

  • Tower Semiconductor's silicon photonics business has $1.3B already contracted for 2027, supporting a raised 2028 revenue target of $3.6B.

  • The most widely read finance newsletter on Substack isn't published by a bank, it's Doomberg, where 383,000+ readers get the energy and macro analysis the mainstream press misses. 24/7 Wall St. readers save 17% on their first year here.

The AI infrastructure trade has crowded into the same handful of megacaps, but the actual buildout runs through dozens of specialty names that most Wall Street desks barely touch. Power delivery from 800V racks, medium-voltage MOSFETs stepping current into GPUs, silicon photonics moving bits between processors: these are the picks-and-shovels layers, and they're where the mispricings live. Below are three chip names with real AI or data-center exposure that are still flying under the mainstream radar heading into the back half of August.

Navitas Semiconductor (NVTS)

Navitas Semiconductor (NASDAQ:NVTS) is the purest small-cap play on the shift to 800V DC architecture inside AI data centers. The market cap sits at roughly $3.64 billion, shares closed at $13.66 on August 13, 2026, and the stock is up 91.32% year to date. Even after that run, coverage is thin: five holds against one buy and one strong buy, with an analyst target of $14.07.

The bull case is the Navitas 2.0 pivot. In Q2 2026, revenue came in at $10.5 million, up 22% sequentially, and CEO Chris Alexander told investors that "high-power markets grew more than 50% year-over-year, serving as further evidence of the building momentum in our GaN and high-voltage SiC products, especially in our focus area of AI infrastructure." Q3 guidance of $13.5 million ±$0.5 million implies 28% sequential growth, and management expects AI infrastructure to be more than one-third of total sales by year-end. Cash on the balance sheet hit $557 million with zero debt after a Q2 raise. Partnerships with NVIDIA's MGX 800V ecosystem, GlobalFoundries for 8-inch GaN, and buffer wafer supply from TSMC give the company optionality most peers lack.

人工智能基础设施行业已经挤进了同样少数的大型企业，但实际的建设涉及数十个大多数华尔街柜台几乎不接触的专业名称。 800V 机架的供电、将电流步进到 GPU 的中压 MOSFET、在处理器之间移动比特的硅光子学：这些是镐和铲子层，也是定价错误的地方。 以下是三个具有真正的人工智能或数据中心曝光度的芯片名称，它们在 8 月下旬仍然受到主流雷达的关注。

纳维半导体 (NVTS)

Navitas Semiconductor（纳斯达克股票代码：NVTS）是人工智能数据中心内向 800V 直流架构转变的最纯粹的小型企业。 该公司市值约为 36.4 亿美元，2026 年 8 月 13 日收盘价为 13.66 美元，今年迄今已上涨 91.32%。 即使在那次上涨之后，覆盖范围也很薄弱：五只持有，一只买入，一只强力买入，分析师目标为 14.07 美元。

最乐观的情况是 Navitas 2.0 的支点。 2026 年第二季度，收入为 1050 万美元，环比增长 22%，首席执行官 Chris Alexander 告诉投资者，“高功率市场同比增长超过 50%，这进一步证明了我们的 GaN 和高压 SiC 产品的发展势头，特别是在我们的人工智能基础设施重点领域。” 第三季度指引为 1350 万美元±50 万美元，意味着环比增长 28%，管理层预计到年底人工智能基础设施将占总销售额的三分之一以上。 第二季度融资后，资产负债表上的现金达到 5.57 亿美元，债务为零。 与 NVIDIA 的 MGX 800V 生态系统、GlobalFoundries 的 8 英寸 GaN 合作以及台积电的缓冲晶圆供应为该公司提供了大多数同行所缺乏的选择权。
